slides.title: Tigray holds local elections
slides.body: District and village votes are underway across the region, The Reporter says.

slides.title: Where voting stands
slides.body: Most districts in Southern Tigray have finished, except Raya Alamata and Alamata town. Voting continues in Eastern Tigray and is paused in two Southeastern districts.

slides.title: How it works
slides.body: Not a party contest: candidates run on personal merit, even if they have party or religious ties. Winners serve an initial six-month term.

slides.title: Officials respond
slides.body: Caretaker official Redai Hailafom called the vote a positive start, said some activities limited public choice and must stop, and pledged faster return of displaced people.

slides.title: Free choice. Safe return for the displaced.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
